correctness.rationale: Factor x^3 det M into the two squarefree cyclotomic factors; local factors of x^n−1 have length k. At cube roots M²=zU and U is a unit, giving one zero Jordan ladder of length 2k per root; at fifth roots trace=1 and determinant has valuation one, giving one nilpotent k-block plus one invertible branch. Scalar extension preserves ranks, and counting nilpotent kernels gives all depth formulas. Finite independent GF2 rank tests for 642 instances and exhaustive simulation of 5120 states agree; they are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The natural graph family exhibits a sharp modulo-3 and modulo-5 invertibility boundary and two distinct powers-of-two transient scales. Explicit block lengths yield a complete infinite-family relaxation-depth and recurrent-state classification, with nontrivial uniform last-depth fractions and arbitrary large sharp transient. This structurally motivated target is more than a one-step kernel table, isolated finite computation, or cosmetic substitution.
